compressionClaim: episode schemas only; train episode facts and answers are not promoted
limitations: The promoted run covered a 10,000-case public train split, but its narrow recurring schema makes this a construction-generalization result rather than a broad knowledge-compression result.
The prepared v1 chunk ledger was not used as a worker completion journal; completion is supported by full-train analysis and candidate validation, not by 20 worker receipts.
No parallel workers generated the promoted model. A parallel assignment and deterministic reduction protocol was added afterward for future runs.
Task 15 measures one-step class-rule instantiation, not arbitrary deductive depth.
The generated model does not include Task 15 test text, answers, entities, or story facts.
Induction and abduction remain runtime methods verified with isolated unit fixtures, not capabilities measured by this dataset.
